Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI Regulation and Safety

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that artificial intelligence does not require new laws, a position that contrasts with concerns raised by current and former employees of AI-focused firms. Huang also criticized a proposal by Anthropic for an antitrust waiver related to AI safety, calling it 'completely unnecessary.' Separately, Huang was reported to be attending a state dinner hosted by Donald Trump for China's Xi Jinping.
